description: Shared schema-15 navigation validation cases: each case applies its statements to a fresh library with every registered migration plus the baseline, then whole-library validation must give the listed outcome natively (verify_application_connection, navigation_tests.rs) and in the browser/test twin (validateApplicationDatabase, navigationValidationParity.test.ts) on node:sqlite and sql.js.
baseline: INSERT INTO study_materials (id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('mat', 'Synthetic', 'x', 'x'), ('other', 'Synthetic', 'x', 'x')

INSERT INTO material_bookmarks (id, material_id, page_index, page_label, originating_content_sha256, title, notes, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('b1', 'mat', 4, NULL, 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 'Charts', '', 'verified', 'x', 'x')

cases.name: the populated baseline is accepted
empty navigation tables are accepted
saved places with an unknown origin, unverified, are accepted
sql: UPDATE material_reading_state SET originating_content_sha256 = NULL, status = 'unverified'
UPDATE material_bookmarks SET originating_content_sha256 = NULL, status = 'unverified'

cases.name: drifted saved places for other content are accepted
exactly 500 bookmarks are accepted
sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 499) INSERT INTO material_bookmarks (id, material_id, page_index, originating_content_sha256, title, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'seed' || i, 'mat', 1, 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 't', 'x', 'x' FROM n

cases.name: 501 bookmarks for one material are refused
sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 500) INSERT INTO material_bookmarks (id, material_id, page_index, originating_content_sha256, title, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'seed' || i, 'mat', 1, 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 't', 'x', 'x' FROM n

cases.name: a claim that cancels a never-issued request is refused
a saved position owned by a never-issued request is refused
a saved position with no claim at all is refused
an orphaned bookmark is refused
sql: INSERT INTO material_bookmarks (id, material_id, page_index, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('orphan', 'gone', 1, 't', 'x', 'x')

cases.name: an orphaned identity is refused
a dropped idx_material_content_sha is refused
a dropped idx_material_reading_state_owner is refused
a dropped idx_material_bookmarks_material is refused
a dropped idx_material_bookmarks_page is refused
a dropped idx_material_bookmarks_hash is refused
an identity table without its lowercase-hex CHECK is refused
sql: ALTER TABLE material_content_identities RENAME TO old_t

CREATE TABLE material_content_identities (material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES study_materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, total_pages INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (TYPEOF(total_pages) = 'integer' AND total_pages >= 1), verified_at TEXT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO material_content_identities SELECT * FROM old_t

cases.name: a claims table without cascade on material deletion is refused
sql: ALTER TABLE material_operation_claims RENAME TO old_t

CREATE TABLE material_operation_claims (material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES study_materials(id), reserved_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (TYPEOF(reserved_generation) = 'integer' AND reserved_generation >= 0), cancelled_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (TYPEOF(cancelled_generation) = 'integer' AND cancelled_generation >= 0), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO material_operation_claims SELECT * FROM old_t

cases.name: an extra column on the reading state is refused
sql: ALTER TABLE material_reading_state ADD COLUMN extra TEXT

cases.name: a missing bookmarks table is refused
